scenes.caption: A story.
scenes.say: Faiza's grandfather tells her about his Hajj.

scenes.caption: Ihram.
scenes.say: First he wore the simple clothes of ihram.

scenes.caption: Tawaf.
scenes.say: He walked around the Ka'bah seven times.

scenes.caption: Zamzam.
scenes.say: He drank Zamzam water and walked between Safa and Marwah.

scenes.caption: Arafat.
scenes.say: On the ninth day he prayed on the plain of Arafat.

scenes.caption: Muzdalifah.
scenes.say: At night he rested at Muzdalifah.

scenes.caption: Eid.
scenes.say: Then came Eid al-Adha, with prayer and sharing.

scenes.caption: Equal.
scenes.say: Faiza learns that in Hajj, everyone stands as equals.
